jcr:title: JCR Queries and Search
author: cms-admin
body:
JCR provides powerful querying capabilities for searching content in Apache Sling applications. The JCR Query API supports multiple query languages including JCR-SQL2, JCR-SQL, and XPath, allowing developers to find content based on various criteria.

Queries can search by property values, node types, paths, and full-text content. The QueryResult interface provides access to search results with support for ordering, limiting, and pagination.

Sling extends JCR querying with resource-based queries and integration with search indexes. Understanding query optimization, indexing strategies, and search result processing is crucial for building performant content applications.
summary: Searching and querying content in JCR repositories within Sling applications.
tags: JCR Queries, JCR-SQL2, XPath, Full-text Search, Query Optimization
title: JCR Queries and Search
